- **L-6693, Kızıltunç Gökay Erdoğan Çorlu (C-97921): not converted.** KYC came back VERIFIED and there was no sanctions hit. However, the customer wants to deposit M$20,000 in cash and asked to keep paperwork to a minimum. When I asked for the specific source of funds and whether they are acting for anyone else, they refused and said they would take the money elsewhere. Their declared occupation (margarine factory worker) also doesn't obviously match the declared source, "business income." I did not open the account or accept the cash. I escalated the case to Compliance (ref ESC-6A580A). Compliance quotes about 10 business days for review.

The branch manager said she can't approve exceptions to KYC/AML policy and wants the numbers anyway. If Compliance clears this customer, the account can open. The M$20,000 deposit would then need a LARGE_CASH report filed the same day. I'll also watch for any attempt to split the deposit below the M$10,000 threshold, which would be reported as suspicious.

I've closed the shift with a handover note covering the open Compliance referral.
